b1_06a.contract: High-address diagnostics must execute independently from low OCM; code, page tables, heap and stack must stay below 0x0002F000, with the final 4 KiB reserved for results. Verify OCM execution and UART before any DDR write.
b1_06a.forbidden_assumption: PS7 declared upper address 0x1FFFFFFF is not evidence of tested board capacity

b1_06b.action: Run the built OCM-resident diagnostic ELF; probe sparse addresses near 0x10000000, then run a 4 KiB single-pattern alias/read-write reproduction.
b1_06b.link_contract: ocm_app ORIGIN=0x00000000 LENGTH=0x0002F000; reserve 0x0002F000-0x0002FFFF for the result record
b1_06b.post_link_gate: Every PT_LOAD range, entry point, vector table, MMU table, heap, processor-mode stack and _end must remain below 0x0002F000; verify with readelf -lW and nm -n
b1_06b.evidence_order: Write RUNNING and the attempted address/operation/width/expected value to OCM before each risky access; on UART pass, failure or timeout, stop the CPU and capture OCM plus PC/SP/CPSR before reset
b1_06b.negative_rule: If the minimal probe does not reproduce the historical failure, audit the old program, build identity and test order before claiming the address is fixed
